description.narrative: Positioning Oxfam's Inclusive Water Governance as core for Climate Resilience This proposal envisions the development of an Oxfam Global Water Framework, that contributes to increased Voice, Agency and Rights of communities (and specifically marginalized groups within) in the governance and management of Water Resources, as a base for secured access to sufficient, clean and affordable water for all, the essence to build climate resilience, ensuring sustainable livelihoods and safeguarding mechanisms from climate change impacts. We foresee a process of 1) inventory of past/ongoing successful experiences, lessons learned and track record; 2) strategizing on water governance/security at regional and global level; 3) donor mapping <(>&<)> proposal development; 4)building of a joint influencing and learning agenda. Consulting the regions in the past weeks, we are impressed by what is already going on in terms of water related programming, and by the enthusiasm to take this forward The framework will enable 1) increased visibility of the Oxfam water/climate related track record, the evidence of impact, the proof of concept of the tools we use; 2) mutual learning, inspirationbetween countries and continents; 3) evidence-based, locally-led funding proposals for a variety of donors; 4) consistent and strengthened influencing on regional and global scale in relation to the rights of communities to water security and decision-making influence in water governance being at the heart of climate resilience and adaptation(WB National Compact process; UN Water Convention; UN Water Conference; CBD COP, GCF NGO network, etc).

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
